description: Natural events tracker (NASA EONET) — Current and recent natural events worldwide from NASA's Earth Observatory Natural Event Tracker: wildfires, severe storms and tropical cyclones, volcanoes, floods, drought, dust and haze, landslides, sea and lake ice, snow, temperature extremes. Each event has category, open/closed status, first seen and last update, latest position, magnitude (acres, kts, etc.), track points and links to the reporting agency. Optional location filter: lat=&lon= or place= with radius_km= (default 500) sorts by distance and reports the nearest event; category= (wildfires, severeStorms, volcanoes, floods, drought, dustHaze, landslides, seaLakeIce, snow, tempExtremes, earthquakes, manmade, waterColor), status=open|closed|all, days= lookback 1-365 (default 30), limit= up to 50. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: geo_natural_events
